prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ makeColumnPlan }`.

`makeColumnPlan(widths, gap)` lays out columns from left to right. `widths` must be an array of finite, non-negative numbers, and `gap` must be a finite, non-negative number. Invalid types or non-finite values throw `TypeError`; negative values throw `RangeError`.

Return `{ columns, totalWidth }`. Each column is `{ index, width, offset }`, in input order. The first offset is zero, and each later offset equals the previous offset plus its width and one gap. `totalWidth` includes gaps only between columns, so an empty input has total width zero and a single column has no trailing gap. Preserve fractional values. Do not mutate or retain the input array, and return fresh objects.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
